about: Coordinator's cut of the frame-time sweep (Nov 17): 8 clean launches at con_custodial y0_p0, one setting (or one pair) changed against the play-setup baseline, base first and last. Each launch: the bench still (5 s settle, 150 frames, screen frames for still_flicker, y0_p0 final.pfm for pfm_brightness and glow_blobs), the revisit, then the 20-turn mouse_lag with the normalised first_turned (db7e0ba). Scored by tests\runtime\sweep_score.py: FASTER only when a variant's frame time beats both bases by more than the floor (the two bases' difference, at least 0.626 ms) and no picture check is worse than base against the original. verify_runtime.ps1 -Variants <this file>.
